title: Relay board keeps the outcome when it drops cells on a narrow screen
findings_note: s352 relay 2026-10-17: `_place` skips the outcome/status cell when it does not fit but still places later, shorter elapsed cells
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the multi-item status format (s352), colors, or the queue pane.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: docs/tui.md (relay board section) says the outcome and status cell takes priority over the elapsed cells. `_place` in `src/slicer/tui.py` drops a cell that does not fit and keeps placing the later, shorter ones, so a narrow board shows `10m00s` with no outcome. A single-item run with a long label hits this at width 24. s352's longer multi-item cell hits it up to width 34.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`, `_place` and the ended-line caller: once the outcome/status cell is dropped, drop the lower-priority cells after it too, or shorten them first; follow the docs' priority order.
- `tests/test_tui.py`; `CHANGELOG.md` under Fixed.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_BoardLines_EndedNarrowWidth_NoElapsedWithoutOutcome`: a multi-item ended run at width 30 shows no elapsed cell unless the outcome cell is shown.
- `test_BoardLines_EndedWideWidth_KeepsAllCells`: unchanged layout at width 80.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch the first go red.
2. Enforce the priority in `_place` (or at its caller) without changing wide layouts.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check (old skip-and-continue rule).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
